geometry.family: 33 original AA local histories per side, explicitly identified labelled seam
geometry.completion: minimal transitive union; no additional bypass relations

measures.two_point_boundary: 1/2 times product of labelled point measures
measures.internal_vertices: labelled product measure, no additional quotient

memory.geometry: oriented seam IDs, footprint subsets and interval histograms capped at four per mask
memory.local_data: local pair coefficients including zero-relation rows, vertex terms, history weights, preparation and joint conditional amplitude
memory.may_integrate_conditionally: past density when all local action and preparation factors are retained
memory.forbidden_loss: independent averaging of retained clocks or fields, or elimination before adding cross influence

influence_functional.application: to joint conditional local integrands before eliminating retained variables

domain.test_space: Phi_A=(L2(eta_A) algebraic_tensor Schwartz(R^2)) invariant under simultaneous point exchange, with projective tensor topology
domain.interpretation: continuous sesquilinear test-state pairing; Phi_in to anti-dual Phi_out_prime
domain.prescription: common positive Abel regulator on each of the four joint interior fields, then epsilon down to zero in test pairings

error_contract.action_reconstruction_error: exactly zero on all 1089 pairs for all real fields and all density strata
error_contract.sewing_pairing_error: exactly zero at every common epsilon>0 and in the test-paired Abel limit
error_contract.regulator_error: E_epsilon(g,f)=abs(B_epsilon(g,f)-B_0(g,f)); no uniform rate asserted for all test states
error_contract.positive_density_numerical_quadrature: not performed; covered by the exact identity
error_contract.history_truncation_error: not bounded outside the declared finite family
